import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='xz8lX1K'].copy()

d0 = sub[sub['date']=='10/20/25']
# baseline: other days
base = sub[sub['date']!='10/20/25']

# aggregate by resource keys
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
agg0 = d0.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].sum()
aggb = base.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].mean()

cmp = pd.concat([agg0.rename('d20'), aggb.rename('base_mean')], axis=1)
cmp['diff'] = cmp['d20'] - cmp['base_mean']
print(cmp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(20))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

d0 = sub[sub['date']=='10/20/25']
base = sub[sub['date']!='10/20/25']

agg0 = d0.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].sum()
aggb = base.groupby(keys).agg(base_mean=('unblended_cost','mean'), base_std=('unblended_cost','std'))

cmp = pd.concat([agg0.rename('d20'), aggb], axis=1)
cmp['diff'] = cmp['d20'] - cmp['base_mean']

# z-score relative to baseline
cmp = cmp[cmp['base_std']>0]
cmp['z'] = (cmp['d20'] - cmp['base_mean']) / cmp['base_std']
print(cmp.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(15)[['d20','base_mean','base_std','diff','z']])

print("total diff:", cmp['diff'].sum())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='xz8lX1K'].copy()

# Look at daily totals and flag anomalous days
daily = sub.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum()

for d,v in daily.items():
    z = (v - daily.mean())/daily.std()
    print(d, round(v,2), round(z,2))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Check commitment fields for R2
r2 = sub[(sub['csp']=='AWS')&(sub['cloud_service']=='3wTal')&(sub['application']=='sDS')&(sub['instance_family']=='W4ugKNiEYE')]

# Compare price of R2 vs other resources on 10/19 vs 10/20
# Check if price change is unique to this resource
print()

merged['price_diff'] = merged['price_a'] - merged['price_b']
print(merged[merged['price_diff'].abs()>0.001][['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price_b','price_a','num_instances_b','num_instances_a']].to_string())
"}
